target.statement: AHIQ achieves PLCC 0.989 and SROCC 0.984 on the LIVE dataset (full-reference IQA).

compute.basis: Training AHIQ (ViT-B/16 + ResNet50) for 50 epochs on LIVE requires a GPU; on CPU it would take many hours, and the paper reports 30 min/epoch on PIPAL (much larger than LIVE), so LIVE training is feasible on a mid-range GPU but not on a CPU-only laptop within a few hours.

blockers: Training requires a GPU (paper used RTX2080 Ti); CPU-only laptop would be too slow.
Code release may not include exact training configs/scripts for LIVE; reproduction may require reimplementation.
ViT-B/16 pretrained weights and ResNet50 weights need to be downloaded (public but adds setup time).
title: Attentions Help CNNs See Better: Attention-based Hybrid Image Quality Assessment Network
